facts.label: Built for
facts.value: John — my boyfriend, a serious avgeek

facts.label: Mount
facts.value: Screw-free assembly — fir-tree pins, snap-in cable gate

story: John is an avgeek — the kind of person who can identify an aircraft by its engine hum. I wanted to build him the ideal flight display: an e-ink panel showing live flight information in a layout clean enough to glance at across the room.

Three things fought me. AI layout tools couldn't produce the precise arrangement I wanted. The e-ink firmware resisted everything I threw at it. And reliable flight information turned out to be genuinely hard to source. So I split the problem in half: the display and frontend on one side, the information-gathering backend on the other, and solved each on its own terms.
The mount got the same treatment — a screw-free assembly with fir-tree pins and a snap-in cable gate, iterated through printed versions until the pins seated at exactly 3.6mm.
It was a surprise gift. It worked. He uses it every day — which is the only metric that matters for this one.
tagline: An e-ink frame that displays the flight above you!
title: PlaneFrame
